findings.claim: §12.7.3's multi-maintainer guidance ('For multi-maintainer adopters who want review enforcement: the script preserves any existing required_pull_request_reviews shape ... Configure your review-shape via the standard GitHub UI or API; the SCP helper won't touch it') does not include an inline cross-reference to §12.7.4's dismiss_stale_reviews: true requirement. A multi-maintainer adopter who completes the §12.7.3 helper invocation without reading §12.7.4 will configure their review-shape without knowing that dismiss_stale_reviews: true is non-optional and will not be set by the helper.
findings.evidence: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 line 865: 'For multi-maintainer adopters who want review enforcement: the script *preserves* any existing `required_pull_request_reviews` shape rather than nulling it (per 020G fix-round-1 SAF-002 closure). Configure your review-shape via the standard GitHub UI or API; the SCP helper won't touch it.' No mention of dismiss_stale_reviews: true. ADOPT-001 §12.7.4 line 904 (much later, in the break-glass section): '**AND `dismiss_stale_reviews: true`**... The `enable-required-check.sh` helper preserves your existing review-shape verbatim and does NOT set `dismiss_stale_reviews: true` for you; configure it explicitly via the GitHub branch-protection UI or API.' The §12.7.3 guidance correctly instructs multi-maintainer adopters to configure review-shape independently but omits the required dismiss_stale_reviews: true flag, whose absence allows stale reviews to persist across pushes. The COMP-MIN-001 setup-sequence gap (deferred to v1.1) amplifies this: without an explicit 'read §12.7.4 before completing review-shape configuration' instruction, the two-section dependency is undocumented.
findings.impact: Low for adopters reading §12.7 end-to-end who encounter the requirement in §12.7.4. The security consequence of a missed dismiss_stale_reviews: true setting is that a CODEOWNER review on an initial commit persists across subsequent commits in the same PR — specifically the attacker scenario described in §12.7.4 (push malicious commits after obtaining a clean review, then merge without re-review). The gap is bounded to multi-maintainer adopters who complete §12.7.3 setup without reading §12.7.4; single-operator adopters are unaffected.
findings.mitigation: Add one sentence at the end of the §12.7.3 multi-maintainer paragraph: 'Multi-maintainer adopters must also ensure dismiss_stale_reviews: true is set — see §12.7.4 for the security rationale and the explicit note that the helper does not configure this.'
